predecessors.name: Federated Republic of Mexico

predecessors.name: Second Mexican Empire
predecessors.text: the Imperial holdings (Mexico City, Querétaro, Veracruz) returned in June 1867

ledger.x: 15 July 1867: Juárez re-enters Mexico City and the Republic is restored.
1873: the Rio Grande's shift costs Mexico a sliver.
November 1876: the Restored Republic gives way to the Porfiriato.
27 September 1882: the boundary treaty with Guatemala.
1911: the Maderistas hold ground in Chihuahua.
21 May 1911: the Treaty of Ciudad Juárez ends the Maderista revolt.
1963: the Chamizal tract returns to Mexico.
1963: in return Mexico transfers 1.07 km2 (260 acres) to the United States under the same Chamizal treaty.
24 November 2009: six Rio Grande islands pass to Mexico.

certainty.note: Frontiers with the United States run along the Rio Grande and the 1848/1853 lines, but the Guatemalan border is unsettled until the treaty of 27 September 1882 and the Yucatán interior is not controlled (Caste War, page).

The Guatemalan frontier is sharp from the 1882 treaty (demarcation completed 1899) and the US frontier from the 1884 treaty on the Rio Grande (the middle of the river, regardless of channel changes); Quintana Roo and the Belize frontier…
